notes.title: Mini Patch 0.05
notes.content:
* If player is killed by an enemy, helpful hints will appear during the death sequence screen to guide players

* Added "-" and "+" signs to the settings menu for Brightness, Audio, and Mouse Sensitivity settings so players have a better sense of which direction is decrease/increase

* Added an ending screen for Players (an email from Genesis Employers) :))))

notes.title: June 23 Patch
notes.content:
* Added clarification to instructions in the main hall: Player cannot sprint while holding the phone

* Added clarification to instructions in the main hall: There is only ONE target vehicle in each parking section now (separated by Section C, Section B, Section A)

* Added clarification regarding enemy behavior: Some enemies ONLY have vision and no hearing. Player can simply crouch/hide behind cars to avoid them. Some enemies ONLY have hearing and no vision; in this case, player will need to be crouching or walking to avoid detection. Other enemies have both; in this case, a combination of tactics will be needed.

notes.title: Mini Update 0.03
notes.content:
Patched a few tiny issues after the first major update, including:

- Respawn bug (fixed player stuck in slow speed after respawning)
- Level 2 AI Adjustment (Decreased the difficulty for Level 2 AI)

notes.title: BELOW LEVEL | Revamping Maps, Graphics, and Playstyle!
notes.content:
Hello fellow Genesis employees! I am excited to announce that Below Level's first major update is now LIVE! After analyzing several valuable feedback, I have decided to implement a full game makeover. The current update includes:

- Improved Graphics! (Detailed lighting, upgraded materials, enhanced shadows, replacement of SSR with Accurate Reflection Captures)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45020632/27799502dcea809b6d64f1af8751a98463ccefb0.jpg

- Map ReDesign (The critique of the previous map being too small and repetitive was taken into account; there are now four new sections/levels, each containing a unique set of abnormals that have been tailored to fit the attributes of their level) 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45020632/5e2cb8e46a3e9ff2e8016602ae2ee84a7d6561b9.jpg

- Play Style Upgrade (The player is now able to traverse across multiple sections of a larger map, and can experience all six unique abnormals in their respective levels. To offer a fulfilling and refreshing experience, enemies are no longer randomized, but the target vehicles are still randomized each game. There is now only ONE target vehicle in each level, which means that the player can focus on experiencing the horrors of each level as they move through the parking lot, rather than remain stuck in a single confined space)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45020632/04293962e1b048ec8fddf165ed1d004c4db662fb.jpg

- Adjusted Difficulty (The enemy AI has been adjusted to offer a good balance between difficulty and enjoyment. Permadeath has also been removed; after dying on a level, the player will respawn with all acquired targets saved)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45020632/9b7d84ae28c6e3f2ddf2963002583df3d605384d.jpg

- Menu! (Addition of a handy menu screen for pre-game settings adjustment)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45020632/1293c155ed713599a33e942958de9d348ca7f911.png

And that's it for this update! Thank you all for your support!
